goals.title: Show the Omega bridge converting both ways on a Mac
goals.description: Clone on a Mac, ./omb setup, ./omb verify and ./start: C/Python -> .om -> C, Python, native, wasm -> .om, every form compared on seeded inputs, with a negative control and a local UI.

milestones.description: Pinned Spark setup, omb CLI (convert, run, roundtrip, verify) and the local UI
Lifter pinned (aien-dev/omega-lift) with gen/lift.c and gen/lift.py; round trip byte-identical
native.om C builds on macOS (native-darwin pin) and NATIVE passes on the Mac
Replace omb's Python harness with Omega units
